required_user_purchases: A legitimate Fallout 3 or Fallout 3 GOTY license
The storefront/platform normally required by the owned edition

dependencies.name: ReShade
dependencies.notes: Official project documents D3D9 and color/depth access. Fallout 3 depth-buffer usability remains a live calibration gate.

dependencies.name: SuperDepth3D
dependencies.license: Proprietary; free for personal use only
dependencies.notes: Generates depth-derived stereo including side-by-side output. VRClient does not copy, mirror, package, or download the shader.

dependencies.name: Osiris VR Viewer
dependencies.notes: OpenXR viewer for full/half SBS and TAB sources with head-output options. SteamVR and wireless Virtual Desktop operation still require headset verification.

dependencies.name: OpenXR SDK and loader
dependencies.notes: The native x86 bridge uses the standard loader and runtime selection only.

dependencies.name: MinHook
dependencies.notes: Provides the x86 trampoline used only after the Fallout3.exe SHA-256, RVAs and render-entry bytes match a reviewed profile.

dependencies.name: VirtualDesktopXR
dependencies.version: provided by current Virtual Desktop Streamer
dependencies.notes: Standard OpenXR runtime path; VRClient adds no proprietary integration. SteamVR transport is also supported by selecting SteamVR OpenXR.

dependencies.name: SteamVR OpenXR runtime
dependencies.notes: Free runtime. VRClient detects the standard OpenXR manifest and does not handle Steam credentials.

dependencies.name: Fallout Script Extender
dependencies.author_project: Ian Patterson, Stephen Abel, Paul Connelly and contributors
dependencies.notes: Supports retail/Steam 1.7.0.3 and GOG; Steam 1.7.0.4 requires a compatible downgrade before FOSE use.

dependencies.name: Fallout Anniversary Patcher
dependencies.license: Restricted asset permissions; included xdelta3 Apache-2.0 and SHA1 MIT components do not license the whole package
dependencies.notes: Only guided when Steam 1.7.0.4 needs FOSE-compatible 1.7.0.3. VRClient never runs it silently.

dependencies.name: Mod Organizer 2
dependencies.notes: Preferred isolated-profile layer. Existing profiles and load order are preserved.
